item.title: The Walt Disney Company (FOX) choses for localised playout
item.description: Media Choice has been servicing Disney for multiple years with localised playout (ad-insertion) and channel delivery to operators in the Benelux. Besides the Disney Jr. localised versions (Belgian Flanders/Wallonia), FOX choses also to work with Media Choice for National Geographic Channel to make a localised version in Belgian Wallonia and to distribute it out to the operators. Starting October 1st 2019. [...]

item.title: REVOLT TV rolls out in the Benelux with localised playout solution
item.description: REVOLT TV, is a music cable network from Sean Combs dedicated to the creators of this generation with unapologetically Hip Hop, choses for the Media Choice localised playout solution with ad- and combination of program insertion for the Netherlands (Ziggo/KPN). Starting November 1st 2019. [...]

item.title: XITE NETWORKS choses for self managed cloud playout solution
item.description: Xite Networks, owner of the succesful 24/7 music tv channels with the most popular music videos, has chosen for the Media Choice self-managed broadcast cloud playout solution. Media Choice is going to roll out these mediaservices the coming up months (mid 2020) for XITE NL, XITE Germany, XITE Belgium and the XITE 4K channel. ​ [...]

item.title: Media Choice selected partner of Amazon Prime Video for Global Video-on-Demand and Linear TV delivery
item.description: OUTtv LIVE in multiple countries Since October 2020, Media Choice is empowered as selected partner of Amazon Prime Video for Global Video-on-Demand delivery.
